```{r setup}
source("utils.R")
source("config_load.R")

PARADIGM    <- params$paradigm
TRIALS      <- params$trials     # "correct" | "alltrials"
DATE_ERP    <- NULL          # NULL = latest ERP CSV; or pin a date, e.g. "20261031"
DATE_ACTION <- "20261016"
DATE_STR    <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d")

PARADIGM_REAL <- strsplit(PARADIGM, "-")[[1]][1]
STUDY         <- if (PARADIGM_REAL == "active") "Active" else "Passive"

DATA_ROOT      <- glue("L:/EEG_Flow_data/Study_EEG_Flow_{STUDY}/derivatives_v2/outputs/measures/load/")
BEHAV_ROOT     <- glue("L:/EEG_Flow_data/Study_EEG_Flow_{STUDY}/derivatives_v2/outputs/measures/behavior/")
OUTPUT_RESULTS <- glue("L:/EEG_Flow_data/Study_EEG_Flow_{STUDY}/derivatives_v2/outputs/stats/load/correlations_action/")



dir.create(OUTPUT_RESULTS, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

included_participants <- if (PARADIGM_REAL == "active") INCLUDED_ACTIVE else INCLUDED_PASSIVE
n        <- length(included_participants)
n_source <- length(included_participants)

# ==============================================================================
# Component definitions
# ==============================================================================
if (PARADIGM_REAL == "active") {
  components <- list(
    list(label="N1 standard",    stim="standard",        window="90-130ms",  cluster="frontal",         source="stim"),
    list(label="N1 target",      stim="target",          window="90-130ms",  cluster="frontal",         source="stim"),
    list(label="N1 novel",       stim="novel",           window="90-150ms",  cluster="central",         source="stim"),
    list(label="MMN target",     stim="target-standard", window="130-190ms", cluster="frontal",         source="diff"),
    list(label="MMN novel",      stim="novel-standard",  window="120-180ms", cluster="centro_parietal", source="diff"),
    list(label="N2 target",      stim="target",          window="180-230ms", cluster="central",         source="stim"),
    list(label="N2 novel",       stim="novel",           window="150-220ms", cluster="central",         source="stim"),
    list(label="P3early target", stim="target",          window="280-430ms", cluster="parietal",        source="stim"),
    list(label="P3late target",  stim="target",          window="500-799ms", cluster="parietal",        source="stim"),
    list(label="P3early novel",  stim="novel",           window="180-270ms", cluster="central",         source="stim"),
    list(label="P3late novel",   stim="novel",           window="300-400ms", cluster="central",         source="stim")
  )
} else {
  components <- list(
    list(label="N1 standard",    stim="standard",          window="90-130ms",  cluster="frontal",         source="stim"),
    list(label="N1 deviant",     stim="deviant",           window="90-130ms",  cluster="frontal",         source="stim"),
    list(label="N1 novel",       stim="novel",             window="90-150ms",  cluster="central",         source="stim"),
    list(label="MMN deviant",    stim="deviant-standard",  window="130-190ms", cluster="frontal",         source="diff"),
    list(label="MMN novel",      stim="novel-standard",    window="120-180ms", cluster="centro_parietal", source="diff"),
    list(label="P3early novel",  stim="novel",             window="190-280ms", cluster="central",         source="stim"),
    list(label="P3late novel",   stim="novel",             window="300-380ms", cluster="central",         source="stim")
  )
}

# ==============================================================================
# Load ERP CSVs
# ==============================================================================
path_stim  <- find_stim_measures(DATA_ROOT, PARADIGM_REAL, "load", "raw", TRIALS, DATE_ERP)
df_stim    <- read.csv(path_stim) %>%
  filter(participant %in% included_participants) %>%
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = CONDITION_LEVELS))

path_diff  <- find_stim_measures(DATA_ROOT, PARADIGM_REAL, "load", "diff", TRIALS, DATE_ERP)
df_diff <- read.csv(path_diff) %>%
  filter(participant %in% included_participants) %>%
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = CONDITION_LEVELS))

# Action score
fname_action <- glue("{DATE_ACTION}_{PARADIGM_REAL}_action_score.csv")
df_action <- read.csv(file.path(BEHAV_ROOT, fname_action)) %>%
  filter(participant %in% included_participants) %>%
  select(participant, action_past_hours)

# Median split
median_score <- median(df_action$action_past_hours, na.rm = TRUE)
df_action <- df_action %>%
  mutate(experience = if_else(action_past_hours >= median_score, "high", "low"),
         experience = factor(experience, levels = c("low", "high")))

cat("Loaded:", n_distinct(df_action$participant), "participants\n")
cat("Median action score:", round(median_score, 2), "h\n")
cat("Low exp:", sum(df_action$experience == "low"),
    "| High exp:", sum(df_action$experience == "high"), "\n")
```

```{r helpers}
# Extract cluster mean amplitude for one component
get_erp_df <- function(comp) {
  chs <- CLUSTERS[[comp$cluster]]
  
  if (comp$source == "diff") {
    stim_col <- if ("stim" %in% names(df_diff)) "stim" else "contrast"
    df_src <- df_diff %>%
      filter(.data[[stim_col]] == comp$stim,
             window == comp$window,
             ch_name %in% chs) %>%
      group_by(participant, condition) %>%
      summarise(mean_amp_uv = mean(mean_amp_uv, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  } else {
    df_src <- df_stim %>%
      filter(stim == comp$stim,
             window == comp$window,
             ch_name %in% chs) %>%
      group_by(participant, condition) %>%
      summarise(mean_amp_uv = mean(mean_amp_uv, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  }
  
  if (nrow(df_src) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  df_src %>%
    left_join(df_action, by = "participant") %>%
    mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = CONDITION_LEVELS))
}

format_lm_apa <- function(fit, term) {
  s    <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  if (!term %in% rownames(s)) return(glue("{term}: not found"))
  b    <- round(s[term, "Estimate"], 3)
  se   <- round(s[term, "Std. Error"], 3)
  t    <- round(s[term, "t value"], 2)
  p    <- s[term, "Pr(>|t|)"]
  p_str <- format_p(p)
  glue("b = {b}, SE = {se}, t = {t}, {p_str}")
}
```

## Results

```{r analysis, results='asis'}
summary_rows <- list()
apa_texts    <- list()

for (comp in components) {
  label <- comp$label
  cat(glue("\n\n### {label}\n\n"))
  
  df_comp <- get_erp_df(comp)
  if (is.null(df_comp) || nrow(df_comp) == 0) {
    cat(glue("> Warning: no data for {label}\n\n"))
    next
  }
  
  n_valid <- n_distinct(df_comp$participant)
  cat(glue("N = {n_valid} | Window: {comp$window} | Cluster: {comp$cluster}\n\n"))
  
  # ── Regression: amplitude ~ condition * action_past_hours ─────────────────
  # Center action_past_hours for interpretability
  df_comp <- df_comp %>%
    mutate(action_c = action_past_hours - mean(action_past_hours, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  fit <- lm(mean_amp_uv ~ condition * action_c, data = df_comp)
  s   <- summary(fit)
  
  cat("**Linear regression:** amplitude ~ condition × action_past_hours (centered)\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(round(s$coefficients, 3), digits = 3))
  cat(glue("\nR² = {round(s$r.squared, 3)}, adj. R² = {round(s$adj.r.squared, 3)}\n\n"))
  
  # ANOVA table for the regression
  aov_tbl <- anova(fit)
  cat("**ANOVA table:**\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(round(aov_tbl, 3), digits = 3))
  cat("\n")
  
  # APA per term
  terms <- c("conditionComplex", "action_c", "conditionComplex:action_c")
  apa_parts <- sapply(terms, function(t) glue("{t}: {format_lm_apa(fit, t)}"))
  names(apa_parts) <- NULL
  apa_parts <- gsub("conditionComplex:action_c", "Load × Experience interaction", apa_parts)
  apa_parts <- gsub("conditionComplex", "Load effect (Complex vs Simple)", apa_parts)
  apa_parts <- gsub("action_c", "Action experience (centered)", apa_parts)
  
  for (ap in apa_parts) cat(glue("- {ap}\n\n"))
  cat("\n")
  
  apa_texts[[label]] <- paste(
    glue("**{label}**"),
    paste(apa_parts, collapse = "\n\n"),
    sep = "\n\n"
  )
  
  # ── Median split ANOVA ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  cat("**Median split ANOVA:** amplitude ~ condition × experience\n\n")
  
  df_wide_ms <- df_comp %>%
    group_by(participant, condition, experience) %>%
    summarise(mean_amp_uv = mean(mean_amp_uv, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  res_ms <- anova_test(
    data        = df_wide_ms,
    dv          = mean_amp_uv,
    wid         = participant,
    within      = condition,
    between     = experience,
    type        = 2,
    effect.size = "pes"
  )
  
  tbl_ms <- get_anova_table(res_ms, correction = "auto")
  print(knitr::kable(tbl_ms, digits = 3))
  cat("\n")
  
  # Boxplot — median split
  p <- df_wide_ms %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = condition, y = mean_amp_uv, fill = experience)) +
    geom_boxplot(color = "black", outlier.shape = 21, position = position_dodge(0.8)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("low" = "#AED6F1", "high" = "#1A5276"),
                      name = "Experience") +
    scale_y_reverse() +
    labs(title    = glue("{label} | {comp$window} | {comp$cluster}"),
         subtitle = glue("N = {n_valid} | median split = {round(median_score, 1)}h"),
         x = NULL, y = "Mean amplitude (µV)") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) + theme(legend.position = "top")
  print(p)
  cat("\n")
  
  # Summary row
  tbl_ms_df <- data.frame(tbl_ms, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  tbl_ms_df[["component"]] <- label
  tbl_ms_df[["window"]]    <- comp$window
  tbl_ms_df[["cluster"]]   <- comp$cluster
  summary_rows[[label]]    <- tbl_ms_df[, c("component","window","cluster",
                                              setdiff(names(tbl_ms_df),
                                                      c("component","window","cluster")))]
}
```
